data.adjudication: Reported contribution; no quid pro quo established.
data.claim: A PAC started by Zeldin received a $50,000 contribution from a company tied to a former plastics-industry executive after Trump announced the EPA nomination, raising questions about separation from the PAC.
clear_connection_paths: Lee Zeldin → Leadership America Needs PAC → post-nomination $50,000 donor tied to plastics industry → EPA authority

title: Zeldin PAC received $50,000 after EPA nomination
